title: Kim Scott on Google's S-1: 'founder primacy' is the greater danger
summary: Scott was at Google in 2004 and cheered the dual-class shares that fought off Wall Street. She has since learned the structure was an old trick the NYSE stopped listing in 1926, and now argues the opposite concentration is the worse risk.
attribution_title: Co-founder, Radical Candor; author of Radical Candor and Radical Respect
blockquote: The only thing more dangerous for our economy than shareholder primacy is founder primacy. Eric Ries lays out the research on why, and what to do about it, in his excellent book Incorruptible.
